verdict.rationale: Pylon documents agents that gather internal context and use connectors or admin-defined Custom API tools to retrieve information from internal or third-party systems. Assist Agent also works with the account and issue context already in Pylon, so answers can draw on live customer data beyond help articles. However, the docs never show customer-facing answers personalized with plan, order status or account history. Pulling external live data also requires an admin to configure connectors or API tools. missing for 10: explicit documentation of customer-facing answers grounded in per-customer plan/order/account-history data, concrete examples of live order or plan lookups, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, answers use the customer's live data — plan, order status, account history — not just generic help articles

citations.quote: Support Agents can deflect customer questions using content, gather internal context for your team, and take action.
Connectors give Pylon agents access to external tools so they can search for context, retrieve information, and take action outside Pylon.
an administrator can define a Custom API tool that agents can use to hit internal or third party API endpoints.
Assist Agent is an interactive AI teammate that helps your team investigate questions, draft replies, and take action with the context already available in Pylon.
